1.

2. Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Pandey, Advocate (Roll No. A/A0415/2021) holding brief of Sri Akhilesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the revisionist and Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the records.

3. The present revision has been preferred against the judgement and order dated 30.01.2014 passed by the Sessions Judge, Mahoba, in Criminal Appeal No. 18 of 2012 arising out of impugned judgement and order dated 13.01.2012 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba in Hemraj Shivhare vs State Of U.P. on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106295181/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Complaint Case No. 317/02 (F.I. vs. Hemraj Shiv Hare), Police Station Kabrai, District Mahoba,
convicting and sentencing the appellant under Section 7 (ii) (v) / 16 (1) (a) (i) (ii) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for 03 months rigorous imprisonment & fine of Rs. 500/- and in default of payment of fine to further undergo 15 days additional simple imprisonment.

entities.text: Complaint Case No. 317/02 (F.I. vs. Hemraj Shiv Hare)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. An application for withdrawal dated 20.02.2024 has been filed on behalf of the revisionist and while placing the custody certificate which is annexed as Annexure-1 to the same it is argued that the revisionist was sentenced to 03 months rigorous imprisonment & fine of Rs. 500/- and in default of payment of fine to further undergo 15 days additional simple imprisonment and upto 05.01.2024 being the date of issuance of custody certificate, the revisionist had undergone 02 years & 29 days in jail.

He was in jail in compliance of the order dated 16.10.2023 being arrested on 20.11.2023.
5.
It is submitted that the revisionist has been released from jail on 12.01.2024.

It is submitted that the revisionist had already undergone the sentence as awarded to him by the learned trial court,
paragraph 5 & 6 of the said application has been placed before the Court.

6. The application for withdrawal has been filed with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the present application for withdrawal of Criminal Revision bearing Criminal Revision No. 651 of 2014 (Hemraj Shivhare Vs. State of U.P.), otherwise the revisionist shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury."

entities.text: Hemraj Shivhare Vs. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In view of the above, the withdrawal application is allowed.
The present revision is dismissed as withdrawn.
